Class JdkCollectionsSerializers

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.persistence.kryo.JdkCollectionsSerializers
public class JdkCollectionsSerializers extends Object
Provides dedicated Kryo serializers and registration helpers for JDK collection types.

Specifically handles JDK 9+ immutable collections (List.of(), Set.of(), Map.of()), Arrays.asList(Object[]), Collections unmodifiable wrappers, singletons, and empty collections which otherwise throw UnsupportedOperationException during Kryo deserialization due to mutation in default serializers.
